dedupe_keys.name: autoroutes et peages en flux libre

description: Autoroutes et péages en flux libre is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Maxime Lopes. Qu’est-ce que le péage en flux libre (free flow) ? Les autoroutes adoptant des péages en flux libre n’ont plus de barrières de péages nécessitant de s’arrêter comme sur des postes de péages conventionnels. Les véhicules (voitures, camions, poids lourds, motos et bus) passent sous des portiques installés directement au-dessus des voies. Coverage: Maxime Lopes. The publisher named on the listing is Maxime Lopes. Its keywords include peage, autoroutes, peages, free-flow, autoroute, flux-libre. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX, CSV, GPX, PDF. The listing shows 2025-10-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
